review_notes:
I read the whole file and checked the helper definitions against Mathlib. I found no justified finding.

- `toIntLinearMapOfModules` is the closest match. Mathlib has `AddMonoidHom.toIntLinearMap` in Mathlib/Algebra/Module/LinearMap/Defs.lean, which uses `AddCommGroup.toIntModule`. The local def instead takes arbitrary `Module ℤ` instances as arguments. It is used to build maps whose `Module ℤ` instances come from `Rep ℤ`, and those are not syntactically the Mathlib instance. I read this as a deliberate, different representation, not a competing version of the same concept. The same helper is copied into 16 files under P2M/Sol. That is duplication inside this repository, not a clash with Mathlib, so I did not report it.
- `homAdd` and `homOfLinear` are thin named wrappers. `homAdd` wraps `χ.hom.toLinearMap.toAddMonoidHom`, and `homOfLinear` wraps `Rep.ofHom`. They are not substantive parallel APIs.
- `ρ_ρ_inv` and `ρ_inv_ρ` are standalone lemmas that may overlap Mathlib's `Representation` inverse lemmas. The rubric excludes theorem duplication.
- `ev`, `cob` and `nOf` are local constructions for this proof and have no Mathlib counterpart.

I did not check every one of the 16 copies of the helper for exact equality. The decision does not depend on that.
